name: ICANN
body: HSTS is preloaded, framing is limited, cookies are Secure, and a consent tool is present. But the WebSite JSON-LD on /en has a name and a date and no url, so it can't be tied to the domain.
lesson: Add url, plus a search action if you have one, to each language's WebSite block.
summary: www.icann.org scores 79 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 26 are at risk, and 18 pass. Fix first: 2 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /en/blogs, /en/ceo-corner/ceo-reports-to-the-board. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 14 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: / WebSite lacks url, /ar WebSite lacks url, /zh WebSite lacks url and 11 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.

fix.title: 1 title is shared by more than one page
fix.evidence: "Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers (ICANN)" on /ar, /zh, /fr and 3 more.
fix.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

fix.title: 4 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /en/announcements, /en/blogs, /en/public-comment/proceeding/dnssec-ds-automation-security-stability-assessment-12-10-2026, /resources/pages/social-media-2020-12-14-en. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.
